Navigation

नेविगेशन फिक्स

A specific geographical position determined by visual reference, radio aid, or satellite, used in defining air routes, procedures, or as a reporting point.

Quick answer: A specific geographical position determined by visual reference, radio aid, or satellite, used in defining air routes, procedures, or as a reporting point.
